name: Western Ghats Reforestation
summary: Restores degraded forest land in the Western Ghats, a global biodiversity hotspot, through community-led planting supplied from nearby nurseries.
highlights: Mixed native species raised in local nurseries
Work for 600+ farmers and forest-fringe households
Biodiversity co-benefits checked by a third party

name: Rajasthan Grid-Connected Solar
summary: Utility-scale solar in Rajasthan supplying clean power to a northern Indian grid still dominated by coal, producing additional and measurable emission reductions.
highlights: Solar output displaces fossil-fuelled grid power
Additionality shown using the grid emission factor
Steady record of past deliveries

name: Sundarbans Mangrove Restoration
summary: Replants mangroves in the Bangladesh Sundarbans, storing carbon faster than land forests typically do while giving coastal settlements a natural buffer against the sea.
highlights: Blue-carbon habitat with high uptake per hectare
Shelter for coastal villages from storm surge and erosion
Support for fisheries and local livelihoods

name: Efficient Cookstoves Programme
summary: Supplies fuel-efficient cookstoves to Kenyan households, reducing the firewood they burn, the smoke they breathe indoors and the emissions from everyday cooking.
highlights: Fuelwood use per household cut by up to 60%
Less indoor smoke, with health gains for women and children
Monitoring rooted in the local community

name: Punjab Agricultural Biogas
summary: Anaerobic digesters on Punjab farms convert crop residue and animal waste into biogas, preventing methane release and reducing the need to burn fields.
highlights: Methane captured instead of escaping
Cooking gas plus digestate for use as fertiliser
Less stubble burning each season

name: Cement Plant Waste-Heat Recovery
summary: Recovers heat that cement kilns would otherwise lose and uses it to generate electricity on site, reducing the plant's draw on the grid.
highlights: Electricity made from waste kiln heat
Lower emissions in a hard-to-abate sector
Energy savings metered and verified

name: Assam Smallholder Agroforestry
summary: Plants trees on smallholder farms in Assam, adding a carbon sink to working farmland and giving farming families more varied and higher incomes.
highlights: Farm trees that store carbon and steady livelihoods
Fruit and timber species add a second income
Benefits shared directly with farming households

name: Tamil Nadu Onshore Wind
summary: Onshore wind farms in Tamil Nadu supply the southern grid with clean electricity, taking the place of power that fossil-fuel plants would otherwise generate.
highlights: Utility-scale generation with no emissions
Consistent, carefully documented output records
Operations and maintenance jobs for local people

name: Peatland Conservation & Rewetting
summary: Rewets and protects tropical peatland in Indonesia, keeping its dense carbon stores in the ground by preventing the drainage and fires that release them.
highlights: Guards one of the planet's densest carbon stores
Lower fire risk across the wider area
Community patrols and monitoring

name: Municipal Solid Waste-to-Energy
summary: Sends municipal solid waste to a waste-to-energy plant rather than landfill, avoiding the methane dumped waste would emit and supplying electricity to the grid.
highlights: No methane from open dumping
Less waste for cities to manage
Power generated from non-recyclable waste

name: Organic Waste Composting Programme
summary: Composts segregated organic waste aerobically, avoiding the methane it would give off in landfill and returning the finished compost to farmland.
highlights: Stops methane from organics rotting in dumps
Compost supplied to farms
Encourages waste segregation by municipalities

name: Dairy Cluster Biogas Programme
summary: A group of digesters across a dairy cluster captures methane from cattle manure, supplying households with cooking gas and farmers with slurry fertiliser.
highlights: Manure methane captured across the cluster
Cooking gas for rural homes
Slurry used in place of chemical fertiliser

name: Rice — Alternate Wetting & Drying
summary: Introduces alternate wetting and drying on smallholder paddy fields, so they are not kept permanently flooded, lowering methane emissions and using less irrigation water.
highlights: Substantial methane reduction from rice growing
Meaningful savings in irrigation water
Farmer training and MRV support for smallholders

name: Rural Clean Cookstoves — India
summary: Rural Indian households switch to efficient cookstoves that burn less firewood, produce less indoor smoke and lower the emissions from cooking each day.
highlights: Less fuelwood collected, less pressure on forests
Cleaner indoor air for women and children
Stoves distributed and monitored through communities

name: Solar Irrigation Pumps
summary: Swaps diesel irrigation pumps for solar-powered ones on Indian farms, removing fuel emissions from irrigation and reducing what farmers spend to water crops.
highlights: Diesel taken out of irrigation
Cheaper pumping for farmers
Dependable pumping in daylight hours

name: Steel Plant Waste-Heat Recovery
summary: Captures waste heat from steel production and converts it to electricity, lowering grid demand at a facility in a hard-to-abate industry.
highlights: Power from heat that was being lost
Smaller footprint for heavy industry
Savings metered and independently verified

name: Industrial Energy-Efficiency Retrofit
summary: Retrofits motors, drives and process equipment across Indian manufacturing units, reducing electricity consumption and the emissions that come with it.
highlights: Upgrades along production lines
Smaller energy bills and lower emissions
Savings measured by an independent party

name: Biomass Boiler Fuel Switch
summary: Converts industrial boilers from coal to sustainably sourced biomass, so the process heat they supply comes from a renewable fuel rather than a fossil one.
highlights: Process heat from renewable biomass
Coal removed from boiler operations
Fuel drawn from local agricultural residue

name: Central India Afforestation
summary: Plants trees at scale on degraded land in central India, creating new carbon sinks while providing work and income for surrounding rural communities.
highlights: Large-scale planting of native species
Jobs and benefit-sharing for rural communities
Carbon removal over the long term

name: Bamboo Plantation & Restoration
summary: Establishes fast-growing bamboo plantations in India that take up carbon quickly, improve soil health and support small rural businesses built on bamboo.
highlights: Quick carbon uptake as bamboo grows
Income from sustainably harvested bamboo products
Soil restoration and erosion control

name: Rooftop Solar Aggregation
summary: Groups many commercial and residential rooftop solar systems into one project, with their combined output displacing electricity from the fossil-fuelled grid.
highlights: Clean generation spread across many rooftops
Less reliance on the grid and on diesel
Monitoring aggregated across all sites

name: Small Hydro Power
summary: Run-of-river small hydro plants deliver firm renewable electricity to the grid while keeping their impact on the surrounding river ecology low.
highlights: Renewable power that is firm, not intermittent
Run-of-river design with a light ecological footprint
Replaces fossil-generated grid power

name: Gujarat Mangrove Afforestation
summary: Plants new mangroves along the Gujarat coastline, storing blue carbon in coastal soils and helping protect the shore and nearby communities from erosion.
highlights: Dense blue-carbon sequestration
Shoreline protection for coastal communities
Gains for fisheries and biodiversity

name: Coastal Wetland Restoration
summary: Restores and rewets degraded coastal wetlands in India, rebuilding a carbon-rich ecosystem and, along the way, improving local water quality and habitat.
highlights: Brings back carbon-dense coastal wetland
Better water quality and habitat
Local communities involved in stewardship and monitoring
